summary: Iteration 8 — Price Alert (Preisalarm) feature fully tested. Created /app/backend/tests/test_iteration8_price_alerts.py with 11 pytest cases covering CRUD on /api/price-alerts, idempotency, /check trigger, ownership/auth guards, booking flow regression (search → cart array body → checkout/session returning cs_test_), and recommendations/popular-routes/stations regression. ALL 11 PASS in 2.08s. Frontend Playwright: PriceAlertWidget renders correctly on /search with prefilled threshold (49 ≈ 85% of €57); button transitions from 'Alarm aktivieren' to '✓ Preisalarm aktiviert!' after click while logged in; /alerts page shows alert row and delete works (1→0); /alerts redirects to /login?next=/alerts when unauthed; nav-alerts header link visible only when logged in (label 'ALARME' in DE). i18n verified across all 5 languages (DE/EN/FR/IT/ES) — widget title, lead text, threshold label and CTA button all switch correctly.

regression_results.TestBookingFlow::test_full_booking_flow: PASS (POST /journeys/search → POST /cart [array] → POST /checkout/session returned url with cs_test_ and session_id)

frontend_smoke.i18n_de_en_fr_it_es: PASS (Preisalarm / Price alert / Alerte prix / Avviso prezzo / Alerta de precio — and button labels match)

critical_code_review_comments: server.py:1787 — alert _id derived deterministically from md5(user_id:from_id:to_id:passengers) gives clean idempotent upsert; nice touch. Verified by test_create_is_idempotent_replace_in_place — second POST with different threshold replaces in place (same id).
server.py:1806 — exclude _id by doing doc['id']=doc.pop('_id') before return; matches the ObjectId-exclusion guideline. Same pattern in list (line 1814). No raw Mongo _id leaks through the API.
server.py:1821 — DELETE filters on {_id, user_id:user.id} so cross-user deletion impossible (returns 404). Verified by test_delete_other_users_alert_404.
server.py:1855 — push notifications: iterates all active subscriptions for the user and increments notified for each successful send. Reasonable; no Stripe/billing dependency.
server.py:1832 — _check_price_alerts uses 6h de-dupe window via triggered_at; sensible to avoid spam. Background loop at 1880 (900s = 15 min) plus manual POST trigger at 1864. Good split.
server.py:1873 — bg loop sleeps 45s before first check; aligns with non-blocking startup pattern from iter 7.
frontend pages.jsx:861 — useEffect redirect to /login?next=/alerts when !user works; verified end-to-end.
frontend pages.jsx:888 — triggered banner (border-l-2 red) when last_price <= threshold; nice UX signal.
i18n.jsx:159-171 — all 11 pa.* keys + nav.alerts have full DE/EN/FR/IT/ES translations. No missing entries.
Minor: server.py still uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup') (carried from iter 7). Non-blocking.
Minor: _estimate_route_price randomization (±15%/+5%) is fine for demo but means /check returns slightly different last_price each call — documented in spec as expected. No bug.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (9/9 smoke checks across 5 languages + auth/CRUD flows)

seed_data_creation: None new. Demo user reused from prior iterations. Price-alert test rows are created and cleaned within the test class itself (one delete test + idempotent replace).
